title: 第11章 天机阁少主机缘之人第12章 到访飞仙宗赏赐化神丹
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“少主，你确定是这个方向？”
“青州可是东荒最弱的地方。”
“这种地方，怎么可能出现少主你的机缘之人？”
在距离飞仙宗数百里之外，有一名少年以及一名老者正一路往飞仙宗靠近。
少年名为姬无道，乃是东荒玄州，天机阁的少主，擅长推演未来，测算天机之能。
老者被人称做莫老，乃是姬无道此次外出的护道人，实力达到恐怖的大乘六重。
“莫老，不会错。”
“我有预感，我的机缘之人，就在这个方向。”
“不过，这个方向，似乎是青州势力飞仙宗的所在位置。”
“一路上，有关飞仙宗的事情，我也有所耳闻。”
“按道理以飞仙宗的实力，应该不可能短短几天就将青州其他两大宗门覆灭。”
“难道说，我推算出来的机缘之人，就在这个飞仙宗？”
“这次帮助飞仙宗覆灭其他两大宗门的事，也是他出的手？”
渐渐的，姬无道心中有了一个大胆的猜想。
只不过猜想终究只是猜想，要想证实，就必须亲自去查看一番。
如此想着，姬无道脚下的速度又加快了几分。
“唉，算了，反正在青州，有我在，没人可以伤到少主。”
“一切就随少主吧。”
看着姬无道加速远去的背影，莫老摇了摇头，随即跟了上去。
与此同时，另一个方向，也有一批人朝着飞仙宗赶去。

“我们的人就是死在这里？”
“一个化神境强者，竟然会陨落在青州这种地方，还真是废物一个。”
最前方，一名浑身穿着黑袍的男子冷声道。
身后，跟着十几个同样身穿黑袍的人。
而且，这些人有一个共同特点，那就是在他们的黑袍上，都有一个大大的“影”字。
“长老息怒，说不定对方使用了某种阴险手段，侥幸击杀了我们的人。”
“不过敢杀我们的人，无论他是谁，他都会死无葬身之地。”
“这次有长老您带队，再加上我们这些人，就算对方手段再多，也不可能活命。”
身后，一名黑袍男子奉承道。
“哼，死也太便宜他了。”
“敢惹我们血影楼，我会让他体验一下，什么叫生不如死。”
黑袍长老冷声哼道，随即加快了速度朝着飞仙宗赶去。
身后的黑袍人见状也是立马跟了上上去。
content_en:
"Young Master, are you sure this is the direction?"
"Qingzhou is the weakest place in the Eastern Wasteland."
"How could a person like you, young master, appear in a place like this?"
Hundreds of miles away from Feixian Sect, a young man and an old man were approaching Feixian Sect.
The young man's name is Ji Wudao, and he is the young master of Tianji Pavilion in Xuanzhou, Eastern Wasteland. He is good at deducing the future and calculating the power of Tianji.
The old man, known as Mr. Mo, was Ji Wudao's guardian when he went out this time. His strength reached the terrifying sixth level of the Mahayana.
"Mr. Mo, you can't be wrong."
"I have a hunch that the person of my chance is in this direction."
"However, this direction seems to be the location of Feixian Sect, a powerful force in Qingzhou."
"I also heard something about the Feixian Sect along the way."
"Logically, with Feixian Sect's strength, it should be impossible to destroy the other two major sects in Qingzhou in just a few days."
"Could it be that the person I calculated by chance is in this Feixian Sect?"
"Is it his hand that helped Feixian Sect destroy the other two sects this time?"
Gradually, Ji Wudao had a bold guess in his mind.
It's just that a guess is just a guess after all. If you want to confirm it, you have to check it out for yourself.
Thinking like this, Ji Wudao's feet speeded up a bit more.
"Oh, forget it. Anyway, in Qingzhou, with me here, no one can hurt the young master."
"Just follow everything, young master."
Looking at Ji Wudao's speeding away, Mr. Mo shook his head and followed him immediately.
At the same time, a group of people rushed towards Feixian Sect in the other direction.
"Is this where our people died?"
"A strong man in the realm of gods actually fell into a place like Qingzhou. He is really a loser."
At the front, a man wearing black robes said coldly.
Behind him were a dozen people also wearing black robes.
Moreover, these people have one thing in common, that is, they all have a big word "shadow" on their black robes.
"Elder, calm down. Maybe the other party used some insidious means and luckily killed our people."
"But whoever dares to kill us, no matter who he is, will die without a burial."
"This time, with you, elder, leading the team, and the rest of us, no matter how many tricks the other party has, it's impossible to survive."
Behind him, a man in black robe flattered.
"Hmph, death would be too easy for him."
"If you dare to mess with our Blood Shadow Studio, I will let him experience what it means to live worse than death."
The black-robed elder snorted coldly, and then sped up and rushed towards Feixian Sect.
The man in black robe behind him immediately followed after seeing this.
